highlights: The setup now has the All-Out Attack Generator icon and artwork instead of the Software Hub ones
The Dynamotivation logo on the start screen is now the current logo
Updates are now found through the Dynamotivation website, and the app downloads and starts the new setup for you instead of opening a web page
The setup is now signed twice (SHA-1 and SHA-256) so older Windows versions can read its signature
Windows now installs through a signed setup with per-user install and an uninstaller, replacing the portable exe
Fixed a critical bug that prevented video export on Windows
Improved performance on the pose screen by simplifying unnecessary alpha blending
Fixed the opacity selector of the secondary shadow
Merged the Android releases into one larger package to reduce confusion
Changed the Windows file naming scheme to be clearer for non-technical users
Improved UI hitboxes on touchscreen devices
Added PNG strip export on Android
Enabled video and GIF export on Windows
Fixed scaling issues when exporting at resolutions other than 1080p
Added an option to change the preview resolution on Android
Fixed missing feedback after an import succeeded or failed
Fixed several image locations not working on Android
Made the arranger work within the correct aspect ratio
Fixed various other bugs
Fixed portraits not loading
Fixed some animation timings
Added PNG sequence export
Made extensive behind-the-scenes changes
First release
